item.text: {"analysis_packet":{"certificate":"The incumbent is an online, standard-library, byte-accounted two-segment recency/frequency policy with bounded ghost metadata. Its strongest evidence is interface legality, integer-key eviction reporting, capacity-preserving admission, and online adaptation through ghost hits. Its main heuristic risks are unverified target oscillation, frequency promotion of every resident hit, possible scan pollution, and limited phase-shift evidence. The proposed negative-authority change is a hypothesis only: it may expose previously withheld source distinctions, but without scores it cannot establish improvement.
